query: Trace how phase noise in local microwave oscillators introduces correlated dephasing errors across distributed superconducting qubits.
episodic_reflection: Assess flux noise shielding and Purcell filter configurations when reporting T2 coherence.
sub_queries: Characterize the spectral density and statistical properties of phase noise in local microwave oscillators used for superconducting qubit control.
Determine the physical mechanism and magnitude by which oscillator phase fluctuations translate into dephasing errors for individual superconducting qubits.
Analyze the correlation structure of these dephasing errors across multiple distributed qubits sharing the same local oscillator source.

retrieved_evidence.evidence: ArXiv:2403.1102 - 'Fault-Tolerant Surface Codes at Scale': Demonstrates 2D surface code achieving logical error suppression with physical qubit error rate below 0.1% threshold across 72 superconducting qubits.
Surface code is a topological quantum error correcting code defined on a 2D square lattice of data and syndrome qubits, measuring X and Z Pauli stabilizer operators.
Quantum Tech Wire (Oct 2024): IBM and Google Quantum AI publish milestone in physical-to-logical qubit breakeven using rotated surface codes.
